description: erc7710-leaf-salt/v1 (spec/payment-nonce-and-binding.md section 3): which delegation in a successful receipt binds a payment, which Transfer it pairs with, and which request it pays.
generator: scripts/gen-delegated-spend-vectors.py. Deterministic: rerunning gives these bytes.

conventions.log: address_hex, topics_hex and data_hex as eth_getTransactionReceipt returns them; log_names are labels for readers, not part of the receipt
conventions.position: a log's index among the transaction's own logs, from 0
conventions.delegations: the hops and leaves, with their struct hashes, are in erc7710-statements.json and below
conventions.requests: purpose names a payment-nonce.json vector; binds is the delegation hash of the payment the request binds, or null

keys.label: protocol vectors delegated spend: agent B second spending key
protocol vectors delegated spend: agent B gas account
protocol vectors delegated spend: stranger spending key
protocol vectors delegated spend: stranger gas account

delegations.name: leaf/grant
delegations.note: pins the transfer, one call, the grant nonce as salt
delegations.signer: protocol vectors delegated spend: agent B spending key

delegations.name: leaf/credits
delegations.note: a payment leaf beneath D_AB: open delegate, the exact transfer, one call, the credits nonce as salt
delegations.signer: protocol vectors delegated spend: agent B spending key

delegations.name: leaf/no-call-limit
delegations.note: pins the transfer and carries no call limit
delegations.signer: protocol vectors delegated spend: agent B spending key

delegations.name: leaf/under-salted-hop
delegations.note: a leaf beneath hop/B-salted, the credits nonce as salt
delegations.signer: protocol vectors delegated spend: agent B second spending key

delegations.name: leaf/repay-1
delegations.note: a leaf for the onboarding nonce whose payment was refunded
delegations.signer: protocol vectors delegated spend: agent B spending key

delegations.name: leaf/repay-2
delegations.note: the re-pay leaf: the same nonce, another TimestampEnforcer bound, so another delegation hash
delegations.signer: protocol vectors delegated spend: agent B spending key

delegations.name: hop/B-salted
delegations.note: an intermediate hop agent B salts with the grant nonce and pins the transfer, above a salted leaf
delegations.signer: protocol vectors delegated spend: agent B spending key

delegations.name: child/stranger
delegations.note: a stranger's child beneath the open leaf/credits, salted with a nonce of its own choosing
delegations.signer: protocol vectors delegated spend: stranger spending key

delegations.name: root/second
delegations.note: a one-hop chain from another root, pinning the same transfer as the leaves of the first root
delegations.signer: protocol vectors delegated spend: agent B spending key

cases.name: one-payment
cases.note: one chain, one Transfer of the pinned amount from the root: one payment

cases.name: two-payments-one-root
cases.note: two chains from one root in one transaction, each moving its pinned amount: two payments, each with its own identity and Transfer

cases.name: salted-hop-above-salted-leaf
cases.note: agent B salts its own hop and the leaf beneath it: only the hop, nearest the root, can bind

cases.name: stranger-extends-leaf
cases.note: a stranger signs a child under the open leaf and redeems the chain: the leaf still binds

cases.name: no-call-limit
cases.note: a leaf salted with the nonce but without LimitedCallsEnforcer(1): it pairs and binds nothing, so its Transfer is money nothing can bind

cases.name: no-call-limit-takes-part
cases.note: a leaf without the call limit comes first in log order and takes the one Transfer, so the leaf with the call limit pairs with nothing: the Transfer is counted once

cases.name: two-bindings-one-transfer
cases.note: two binding leaves from one root whose code moves the money once: exactly one binds, the first in log order, which only pairing across the whole receipt shows

cases.name: two-roots-pair-by-root
cases.note: a chain from another root, whose code moves nothing, binds first in log order and pins the same amount: it pairs with nothing, and the first root's leaf takes its own root's Transfer

cases.name: eip3009-transfer-beside-binding
cases.note: an EIP-3009 Transfer from the root beside a binding leaf whose root moved nothing: the Transfer belongs to x402 and pairs with nothing

cases.name: unlisted-manager
cases.note: the events come from a delegation manager the verifier does not list: no chain, and the Transfer is unbound

cases.name: transfer-differs-from-pin
cases.note: the root's code moves another amount than the leaf pins: the leaf pairs with nothing and the Transfer is unbound

cases.name: repay/first-leaf
cases.note: the first payment for the onboarding nonce

cases.name: repay/varied-leaf
cases.note: the re-pay: a leaf varied by its TimestampEnforcer bound binds the same nonce as a new payment

repay.note: a leaf whose payment was refunded cannot be redeemed again, and other args leave its hash, so its identity, unchanged; a payer forms another leaf for the same nonce by another TimestampEnforcer bound
